messages:
maria_customer: Hey team — starting ~09:12 UTC we saw p99 go from ~220ms -> ~1.6s for APAC clients. I sampled traces and a few requests show egress to eu-west-1 before model. request_id: rQ8f3a2. Any idea?

sara_support: @maria_customer sorry about that. Can you paste a full request_id payload and a curl with the X-Request-Id header? looping in @devon_oncall for routing.

api-monitor-bot: Alert: region-egress-spike · service=inference-api · region=ap-southeast-1 · p99=1600ms · spike_start=2026-03-17T09:12:23Z

maria_customer: here's one sample header + trace I grabbed from our side:

maria_customer: ```
curl -H "X-Request-Id: rQ8f3a2" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
# trace (client -> edge -> proxy -> model):
client -> ap-southeast-1 edge  -> proxy (eu-west-1) -> model (eu-west-1)
latencies: client 110ms, edge 45ms, proxy->eu 1400ms
```

devon_oncall: @kai_infra can you check peering/BGP for ap-southeast-1? AS path or community rewrite could cause a prefer-eu path.

kai_infra: pulling BGP dumps and recent route announcements. Quick tcpdump on the ap-southeast edge shows SYN/ACKs to the proxy IP in eu range; TTL suggests the packet traversed >12 hops. digging in the edge->proxy nexthop.

sandeep_platform: looking at routing rules: we do have an overflow fallback that routes to cheaper regions when local capacity is saturated. but metrics show committed capacity for ap-southeast healthy at 09:10-09:15 (util 42%). no autoscale events in that window.

sara_support: @maria_customer one more Q — are you using any explicit region hint in SDK env (REGION or REDWOOD_REGION)? Also which SDK version?

maria_customer: Hosted plan, no env overrides. SDK v2.1.0, default config. No recent deploys on our side.

devon_oncall: I've deployed a short-term policy to pin traffic from that customer to ap-southeast-1 variant (canary pin) while infra traces. watching p99.

api-monitor-bot: Update: region-egress-spike · resolved_for_request=rQ8f3a2 · p99=230ms · resolved_at=2026-03-17T09:21:06Z :white_check_mark:

sara_support: Thanks everyone. We'll open a follow-up ticket and share full traceroutes, BGP diffs, and edge config snapshot. @maria_customer we'll include recommended SDK pinning snippet for now. :slightly_smiling_face:
